alt: Two parallel left-to-right derivations connect substrate traits to engineering problems and methods. Finite working state creates a representation problem answered by Modeling. Probabilistic productive work with observable, interposable seams creates an enforcement problem answered by Alignment. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
